title: Mixed Review: All Forms
description: Every form, shuffled. You have to work out which form each situation needs — the best practice for real conversations.

points.title: Mixed review
points.summary: All forms, shuffled — the most effective way to make them stick.
points.body:
**Why mixed practice works**
Recalling a form yourself (instead of choosing it) and having to work out *which* form a situation needs are the two things that make grammar stick. Mixing the forms forces exactly that.

- Read the cue (→ polite past, → humble …) and the situation.
- Say the sentence aloud before you type.
- Use the hint only when stuck — it counts as 'with hint' and the question comes back sooner.

questions.prompt:
{毎朝|まいあさ}ジョギングを（　）。
→ する · polite present
questions.explanation: する is irregular (する): する → し + ending → **します**.

questions.prompt:
{昨日|きのう}、レストランで{寿司|すし}を（　）よ。
→ {食|た}べる · plain past
questions.explanation: {食|た}べる is a る-verb (ichidan): drop る + て / た → **食べた**.
questions.translation: I had sushi at a restaurant yesterday.

questions.prompt:
{暑|あつ}いですね。{窓|まど}を（　）もいいですか。
→ {開|あ}ける · て-form
questions.explanation: {開|あ}ける is a る-verb (ichidan): drop る + て / た → **開けて**.
questions.translation: It's hot, isn't it? May I open the window?

questions.prompt:
{漢字|かんじ}はまだ{全然|ぜんぜん}（　）。
→ {読|よ}む · can't … (polite)
questions.explanation: {読|よ}む is an う-verb (godan): む → め (え-row) + る, then conjugate like a る-verb → **読めません**.
questions.translation: I still can't read kanji at all.

questions.prompt:
{週末|しゅうまつ}、{一緒|いっしょ}に{海|うみ}へ（　）よ。
→ {行|い}く · let's / I'll … (plain volitional)
questions.explanation: {行|い}く is an う-verb (godan) — with one exception: く → こ (お-row) + う → **行こう**.
questions.translation: Let's go to the beach together at the weekend.

questions.prompt:
{授業中|じゅぎょうちゅう}、{先生|せんせい}に{名前|なまえ}を（　）。
→ {呼|よ}ぶ · passive, past
questions.explanation: Passive: {呼|よ}ぶ is an う-verb (godan): ぶ → ば (あ-row) + れる → **呼ばれた**.
questions.translation: My name was called by the teacher in class.

questions.prompt:
{早|はや}く（　）、{間|ま}に{合|あ}うよ。
→ {出|で}る · if … (ば-form)
questions.explanation: {出|で}る is a る-verb (ichidan): drop る + れば → **出れば**.
questions.translation: If you leave now, you'll make it.

questions.prompt:
{会議|かいぎ}の{前|まえ}に{資料|しりょう}を（　）。
→ {読|よ}む · must … (なければならない)
accept: 読まなければならない
よまなければならない
読まなければいけない
よまなければいけない
読まなくてはならない
よまなくてはならない
読まなくてはいけない
よまなくてはいけない
questions.explanation: {読|よ}む is an う-verb (godan): む → ま (あ-row) + なければならない → **読まなければならない**.
questions.translation: I have to read the materials before the meeting.

questions.prompt:
{部長|ぶちょう}、どちらへ（　）か。
→ {行|い}く · honorific (polite)
questions.explanation: {行|い}く has a special honorific verb: **いらっしゃいます**. (おいでになります also work.)

questions.prompt:
{子供|こども}のころ、{母|はは}によく{手伝|てつだ}いを（　）。
→ する · causative-passive (was made to), past
questions.explanation: する is irregular (する): する → させられた → **させられた**.
questions.translation: As a child, my mum often made me help out.

questions.prompt:
{雨|あめ}が（　）、{出|で}かけましょう。
→ {止|や}む · if / when … (たら)
questions.explanation: {止|や}む is an う-verb (godan): ぬ・ぶ・む → んで (た-form) + ら → **止んだら**.
questions.translation: Let's go out once the rain stops.

questions.prompt:
{昨日|きのう}は{頭|あたま}が{痛|いた}くて、{何|なに}も（　）。
→ {食|た}べる · polite past negative
questions.explanation: {食|た}べる is a る-verb (ichidan): drop る for the ます-stem, then add the ending → **食べませんでした**.
questions.translation: I had a headache yesterday and didn't eat anything.

questions.prompt:
{今|いま}、{何|なに}を（　）の？
→ する · て-form + いる
questions.explanation: する is irregular (する): する → し + ending → **している**.
questions.translation: What are you doing right now?

questions.prompt:
{明日|あした}は{彼|かれ}、（　）よ。{用事|ようじ}があるって。
→ {来|く}る · plain negative
questions.explanation: {来|く}る is irregular (来る): the vowel changes — き(ます/て/た), こ(ない/よう/られる/させる), く(る/れば) → **来ない**.
questions.translation: He's not coming tomorrow — he says he's got something on.

questions.prompt:
{彼女|かのじょ}に{好|す}きだと（　）と{思|おも}う。
→ {言|い}う · let's / I'll … (plain volitional)
questions.explanation: {言|い}う is an う-verb (godan): う → お (お-row) + う → **言おう**.
questions.translation: I think I'll tell her I like her.

questions.prompt:
お{客様|きゃくさま}、お{荷物|にもつ}は{私|わたし}が（　）。
→ {持|も}つ · humble (polite)
questions.explanation: Regular humble: **お + ます-stem (持ち) + します** (more humble: いたします).
